description: Multi-Source Medical Literature Router for Evidence-Based Medicine

suggest.git: needed for full git history access (medit uses git for version stamping in some commands)

notes: via54Medit is an evidence-based medicine tool that queries PubMed, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and 蚂蚁阿福 (antfu).
To use the antfu source, you need Chrome running with --remote-debugging-port=9223 and a logged-in chat.antafu.com session. Use --no-antfu to skip.
Configuration lives in %APPDATA%\medit\config.yaml (or ~/.medit/config.yaml). Run `medit init` to generate a default config.
